new_defects.title: build_tool_is_pinned_in_wrangler_and_ci passes on a file that really does install worker-build without a version
quotes: charter/DONE/s19.md proof 1: `crates/worker/wrangler.jsonc` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` each install exactly `worker-build@0.8.7`, the two versions are equal, and neither file installs worker-build without a version.

crates/worker/src/build_pin.rs: commands are split at whitespace, `&&`, `||`, `&` and `;`, and a segment counts only when it holds the literal word `install` and a literal word starting with `worker-build`.
new_defects.why: The parser sees one segment per line, so an install whose tool name sits on a shell line-continuation line (`cargo install \` then `worker-build --locked`) or behind a shell variable (`cargo install $WB --locked`) contributes no entry at all. I ran both as extra mutants in ci.yml beside the pinned line: the parsed list stayed exactly one Some("0.8.7") and both build_tool tests passed (exit 0) while the step would install the newest worker-build and fail exactly as main did. The reordered-flag form `cargo install --locked worker-build` and both briefed mutants are caught, so the fault this slice exists to prevent in its plain form is held; the wording of the guarantee is stronger than the parser. Fix belongs to the next bounded slice: treat any line holding `worker-build` (or `$`-carried tool names) without a version as a failure, or reject any second install in either file.
